top_signal.title: What do you do when you feel like you are in limbo?
top_signal.summary: I feel like I am losing my mind!    I have two eCom brands - one is struggling and has been all year and one is doing pretty well but had some slow days which makes me feel like its failing.    I am working with new media buyers, its been about a week - I know they need time to get things rolling but I am making myself crazy!    I feel like I am just sitting around waiting to find out if things work - but me spending time doing random tasks may FEEL like im doing something but really I'm not - or i could be making things worse!    What do you do to feel productive but also BE productive while you are in limbo?   And also, how do you stay positive after months and months of things just going up and down?       submitted by     /u/Flashy-Caterpillar40       [link]       [comments]
